data.title: Bitcoin steadies at $85.5k as soaring yields offset regulatory hopes
data.description: Investing.com-- Bitcoin fell slightly on Tuesday, extending losses from the prior session as a surge in global bond yields largely offset optimism over more positive U.S. regulations.
